BiblicalUsage: Shobek was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah, his name set down in the list of those who bound themselves to walk in God's law. Nothing else is told about him, only that he signed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a signature can be a sermon. Shobek put his name to the covenant, and I hold that God honours the men who sign, not only the men who speak.
